questions.question: Which status line layout would you prefer?

options.label: Minimal
options.description: Shows only essential information like current file, cursor position, and branch name in a single compact line. This layout maximizes horizontal space for your code while keeping critical status information always visible.

options.label: Detailed
options.description: Displays comprehensive information including file path, cursor position, git branch, modification status, and encoding across multiple information groups. This gives you full context about your file and workspace state at a glance.
